CustomField.formula: CASE( MOD( Rep_Ownership_Date__c - DATE( 1900, 1, 7 ), 7 ), 0, Rep_Ownership_Date__c + 0 + 1, /* Sun:Rep_Ownership_Date__c+0 wknd day+1 day */ 5, Rep_Ownership_Date__c + 2 + 1, /* Fri:Rep_Ownership_Date__c+2 wknd days+1 day */ 6, Rep_Ownership_Date__c + 1 + 1, /* Sat:Rep_Ownership_Date__c+1 wknd days+1 day */ Rep_Ownership_Date__c + 1 /* Default (Mon/Tue/Wed):Rep_Ownership_Date__c+1day */ )
CustomField.label: Business Day (Next)
